findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_feed" is 1739 chars, far longer than this server's median (294). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feed, get_market_imbalance · Private data: get_jobs, get_yield_closes, get_economic_calendar, get_series, get_document_digests · Public sink: get_feed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feed, get_market_imbalance · Private data: get_jobs, get_yield_closes, get_economic_calendar, get_series, get_document_digests · Public sink: get_feed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
